n_note: Single-seed pilot (n=1). This establishes the measurement pipeline works end-to-end (Jacobian construction, KL-matching, trajectory tracking). A real claim requires >=20-50 seeds per condition, a paired statistical test (e.g. paired t-test or Wilcoxon on rho_A(M_AB) - rho_A(M_B) across seeds), and ideally repeating Stage 4 across seeds to see if the dissociation-margin sign is consistent.
